SYNTHETIC fixture (generated by tests/make_fixtures.py; no real exam content).

A 6-page 'paper' whose every page is a picture of text turned sideways: p1/p3 one way, p2 the other, so the
corpus OCR (Tesseract with no turning) is noise and the questions' manual receipt rects are tall strips.
Questions 1(a), 1(b) (p1), 1(d) (p2) and 2(a) (a strip on p2 and one on p3, turned opposite ways) are
invented. It reproduces the bug fixed in commit 019d047 (receipts.py: read sideways scans): the old tool
OCRs each strip as is, scores ~0 and never records a turn. Used by tests/test_receipts.py.
